appearance.direction: modern, minimal, ticket-like, dense but not cramped
appearance.designSystem: Reuse Basketra modern.css tokens, icons, spacing, focus and responsive primitives.
ticketSemantics: Use one continuous receipt/ticket surface for pending items instead of a card per item.
Use separators, aligned monetary values and a clear estimate footer.
Do not copy the phone frame, prototype bottom navigation, fonts or exact geometry.

content.title: Compra semanal
content.secondaryText: Todo listo para una semana más

referenceStore.label: Tienda de referencia
referenceStore.behavior: Items inherit this store unless they have an explicit per-item override.

completedItems.presentation: Secondary completed section below the active ticket.
completedItems.immediateUndo: After marking an item bought, show a short-lived Deshacer action so accidental completion can be reverted immediately.

itemRowContract: optional product thumbnail when confirmed product-photo evidence exists, otherwise a neutral product icon
latest selected-store price or explicit no-comparable-price state
edit/delete actions with existing Basketra swipe/button/keyboard equivalents
completed items expose a visible return-to-pending action in addition to the accessible completion toggle

storeSelection.listWide: Changing the reference store affects inherited items.
storeSelection.perItem: Changing a row store creates an explicit override for that item.
storeSelection.applyAll: The reference-store chooser exposes an explicit 'use for all items' action that clears item overrides transactionally.

responsive.mobile: Single continuous ticket. Primary product/price line first; quantity, unit, size and store remain editable in a compact secondary control grid without horizontal page overflow.
responsive.desktop: Preserve ticket semantics in a denser table-like receipt; controls may align into columns and the estimate summary may sit beside the ticket only when space permits.
responsive.narrow: At 320-390 px, controls wrap into multiple rows rather than shrinking below touch/legibility requirements.
